prose_updates.tldr: Global prediction accuracy alone does not determine the attainable accuracy of the full-population ATE when treated observations become polynomially rare. In the public-function experiment with bounded global \(L^2(P_X)\) certificates, a fixed conditional-effect signal envelope, and uniform one-sided propensity shells, the exact minimax rate is the four-channel quantity \(\rho_n\): tail-amplified outcome noise, regression error hidden in shells with no treated observations, localized propensity--treated-regression uncertainty, and the regular control-side nuisance interaction. The converse now uses a complete atomic probability law: explicit background and completion atoms, signal cells, and equal-mass balancing companions certify every fixed-sign shell law, including the exact \(\kappa=1\) logarithm. A clipped doubly robust average, a five-block median, and a bias-aware interval attain the matching absolute-risk, root-MSE, fixed-probability, and honest-length frontiers. Adaptation to unknown shell and nuisance certificates remains open.

project_justification.gap: Published regular-overlap structure-agnostic results provide lower-bound templates, but the attested BonviniKennedyDukesBalakrishnan2024StructureAgnosticATE passage concerns one mean functional and supplies neither a control-arm extension nor a joint two-arm ATE theorem. Weak-overlap papers give trimming rules, irregular limits, or sufficient Wald conditions rather than one matched four-risk frontier. The accepted-bank result \(\texttt{stat\_policy\_regret\_margin\_overlap\_v1}\) studies margin-localized policy-welfare regret under coupled Tsybakov margin and one-sided-overlap decay with conditional ERM achievability assumptions. The accepted result \(\texttt{stat\_lmtp\_threshold\_atom\_frontier\_v1}\) studies an exact continuous-exposure clamp functional in finite-stratum polynomial-thinning Hölder or continuity classes with a threshold atom and a causal-transport bridge. Neither accepted-bank target or class subsumes this binary-treatment full-population ATE experiment under public global \(L^2\) certificates, and this experiment does not subsume either accepted result.
project_justification.niche: The public-function model isolates the statistical price of knowing only global prediction-error guarantees when the treated design vanishes at a boundary. The left tail creates three distinct treated-side obstructions, while the control-side product remains regular; the fixed condition \(E_P[(g_1(X)-g_0(X))^2]\leq M\) keeps the ATE finite without a pointwise potential-outcome envelope.
project_justification.fill: The paper gives explicit decision classes, clipped and median estimators, a bias-aware interval, and a law-by-law four-channel converse. The converse specifies dyadic background masses \(b_\ell\), active masses \(w_j=A(1-2^{-\kappa})t_j^\kappa\), balancing companions, completion capacities \(d_\ell\), and completion masses \(\pi_\ell\), with an exact total-mass identity. A relocation inequality verifies every moving shell even at tight global capacity; exact geometric sums verify active tails and the \(\kappa=1\) logarithm; nuisance radii, moments, cancellation, collisions, and target separation are checked fixed-sign by fixed-sign before the four scales are combined into \(\rho_n\).

sampling_model.design: An i.i.d. observational sample augmented by deterministic public nuisance functions \((m_0,m_1,p)\), supplied global \(L^2(P_X)\) error radii bounded by the fixed cap \(\bar r\), a fixed signal envelope \(E_P[(g_1(X)-g_0(X))^2]\leq M\), and decision rules that may use all public inputs.
sampling_model.units: Independent units \(O_i=(Y_i,D_i,X_i)\), \(i=1,\ldots,n\), from a causal law satisfying consistency and conditional ignorability.
sampling_model.treatment: Binary treatment with propensity \(e(X)\), positive almost surely and allowed to approach zero.
sampling_model.overlap: Uniform one-sided dyadic shells satisfy \(c_-u^{\kappa}\leq P\{u/2<e(X)\leq u\}\leq c_+u^{\kappa}\) for \(0<u\leq\lambda_0\), while \(e(X)\leq1-\eta_+\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The minimax infima range over rules measurable in \(O^{(n)}\) that also receive \(m_0\), \(m_1\), \(p\), \(r_{0n}\), \(r_{1n}\), and \(r_{en}\). The same public inputs are fixed within each lower family, the certified radii lie in \([0,\bar r]\), and each fuzzy family uses finite equal-cell refinements of a complete countable reservoir with signal--balancing pairs.

prose_updates.interpretation: The regular-benchmark reduction is only an algebraic check: as \(\kappa\to\infty\), the treated side has the same parametric-plus-product form as the verified published lower-bound templates after their explicit radius identifications. Bonvini's attested one-functional statement is used only for the treated-side mapping \(\varepsilon_n=r_{1n}\), \(\delta_n=r_{en}\); no control-arm term is attributed to that source. The shell class and the regular comparator class are disjoint, so the calculation establishes neither minimax equivalence nor inclusion transfer. The accepted policy-regret and continuous-exposure clamp frontiers answer non-nested causal decision problems under non-nested law classes.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The converse uses reservoir-rich fixed shell constants satisfying \(\texttt{ass:lower-shell-richness}\) and \(\texttt{ass:upper-shell-richness}\). Its probability law is complete: the displayed background mass is less than one half, active signal and balancing masses total \(2As_0^\kappa\), explicit completion masses sum to the remaining mass, and all three pieces sum exactly to one. Every active mass is relocated from a virtual dyadic endpoint into a fixed interior fraction of its shell; the relocation cap proves the upper shell inequality even when nonemptiness leaves no unused global capacity. Treated fuzzy propensities have ratios in \([4/5,4/3]\), control fuzzy propensities in \([3/4,5/4]\), and opposite-tilt companions make each fixed-sign propensity multiset invariant. At \(\kappa=1\), the proof uses exact dyadic sums for \(\lVert f\rVert_2^2\), \(E[e_0f^2]\), and \(E[f]\), not density or integral heuristics. The upper bound needs no reservoir richness, so shell classes outside the stated richness regime may have different converse geometry.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The theorem concerns supplied public functions, bounded certified radii, fixed shell constants, and the primitive signal condition \(E_P[(g_1(X)-g_0(X))^2]\leq M\); it imposes no pointwise potential-outcome envelope and makes no Wald or Gaussian-limit claim. Every minimax rule may use all supplied public inputs. The confidence interval is bias-aware and oracle-calibrated. Adaptation to unknown shell constants, tail exponent, and nuisance radii, bounded-outcome variants, shell constants outside the richness regime, and exact studentized validity remain open. The accepted policy-regret and continuous-exposure clamp papers are non-nested in both target and class. The fast-tail expression is a rate-form comparison to verified published lower-bound templates, not a transferred regular-class minimax theorem.
